verified_facts.text: Casa da Calcada is in the heart of Amarante, beside the waters of the Tamega River.
verified_facts.excerpt: Welcome to this magical house in the heart of Amarante, whose spirit flows to the rhythm of the waters of the Tâmega

verified_facts.text: The mansion sits right on the banks of the river.
verified_facts.excerpt: Right on the banks of a flowing river, a mansion that observes the current and the passing of time

verified_facts.text: The mansion is in the historic part of Amarante, right beside the Tamega.
verified_facts.excerpt: em cuja parte histórica habita, mesmo rente ao Tâmega

verified_facts.text: The suites and rooms overlook the Tamega River and are designed as retreats of privacy, comfort and sophistication.
verified_facts.excerpt: Wellness resorts overlooking the Tâmega River, designed as retreats of privacy, comfort and sophistication.

verified_facts.text: Casa da Calcada is a centuries-old property whose history blends with that of Amarante and Portugal.
verified_facts.excerpt: A centuries-old property. An enchanted past that blends with the history of Amarante and Portugal.

verified_facts.text: Conspiracies in the name of the republic were plotted at the house.
verified_facts.excerpt: where conspiracies were made in the name of the republic

verified_facts.text: Largo do Paco, with its fine dining offering, and Canto Redondo are the hotel's two restaurants.
verified_facts.excerpt: Largo do Paço, with its exclusive fine dining offering, and Canto Redondo are the hotel’s two restaurants

verified_facts.text: Ciao Tilias overlooks the Tamega River and serves Italian cuisine.
verified_facts.excerpt: Overlooking the Tâmega River, Ciao Tílias invites guests to savour authentic Italian cuisine.

verified_facts.text: Breakfast is served at A Margem, with a view over the river and the city.
verified_facts.excerpt: À Margem, with its view over the river and the city, is where the first meal of the day is enjoyed.

verified_facts.text: The house has owned the oldest certified vineyard in the region since 1917.
verified_facts.excerpt: Sacred land since 1917 with possession of the oldest certified vineyard in the region.

verified_facts.text: The Tempo Wellness Center has a heated indoor pool, sauna, Turkish bath, ice fountain, gym and a menu of treatments.
verified_facts.excerpt: Uma oferta completa de bem-estar com piscina interior aquecida, sauna, banho turco, fonte de gelo, ginásio e uma bem desenhada carta de tratamentos.

verified_facts.text: The Tempo treatment menu includes wellness rituals, massages, and facial and body treatments.
verified_facts.excerpt: A nossa carta disponibiliza rituais de bem-estar, massagens, tratamentos faciais e corporais.

verified_facts.text: The Tempo Wellness Center welcomes visitors who are not staying at the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: O Tempo_ convida-o a entrar, mesmo que não esteja hospedado.

Room categories include a Suite with balcony.
